title: It is impossible for the Minister to make policies without the President's knowledge
text:
Thursday, February 6, 2025 – 19:25 WIB
The Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM) Bahlil Lahadalia conducted a sudden inspection (inspection) to one of the 3 -kilogram LPG bases. Photo: Pertamina Public Relations Documentation
jpnn.com JAKARTA – Deputy Chairman of Golkar Ahmad Doli Kurnia felt it was impossible for the minister or head of the agency in the Red and White Cabinet to make a policy without the President’s knowledge.
This was conveyed in response to the description that revealed the Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources who are also Ketum Golkar Bahlil Lahadalia has a different policy from Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto.
“All ministers, not only ministers from Golkar, I don’t think there is a policy to the President’s knowledge. It is impossible,” Doli said answering the media crew on Thursday (6/2).
The Legislator of the House of Representatives Commission II also assessed that it was impossible for a minister to immediately execute the program without coordination of the President
“There is no way there is a minister who dares or who composed the policy without coordination or instructions from the president,” continued Doli.
Previously, Minister Bahlil made a policy to remove retailers in the distribution of three kilograms of LPG or melon gas.
Later, the policy drew criticism. People have difficulty accessing melon gas because they have to queue for hours.
President Prabowo in a statement delivered by Daily Chairman Gerindra Sufmi Dasco Ahmad asked the retailer to continue to sell three kilograms of LPG.
Golkar Deputy Chairman Ahmad Doli Kurnia felt that it was impossible for ministers in the Red and White Cabinet to make policies without the knowledge of President Prabowo Subianto.
